```{r packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lhs)
library(BASS)
library(GPfit)
library(gt)
```

```{r objective-and-settings}
set.seed(123)

# Objective function to minimize
f <- function(x) {
  x <- pmin(pmax(x, 0), 1)  # clamp to [0,1]
  term1 <- sin(10 * pi * x) * (1 - x)
  term2 <- 0.25 * cos(24 * pi * x^2)
  jump  <- ifelse(x > 0.62, 0.8, 0.0)
  bump  <- 1.2 * exp(-120 * (x - 0.18)^2)
  valley <- -1.0 * exp(-80 * (x - 0.78)^2)
  term1 + term2 + bump + valley + jump
}

# Experiment settings
n0 <- 5
budget <- 80
grid_n <- 1000
kappa <- 2.0
eps <- 1e-8

x_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = grid_n)

# Helper
closest_idx <- function(x, grid) which.min(abs(grid - x))
```

```{r initialization}
# Shared initialization across all methods
x_init <- maximinLHS(n0, 1)[, 1]
y_init <- f(x_init)

init_df <- tibble(x = x_init, y = y_init)
init_df
```

```{r bass-bo-function}
run_bass_bo <- function(x_init, y_init, x_grid, budget, kappa) {
  evals <- tibble(x = x_init, y = y_init)
  
  # Avoid exact repeats on the candidate grid
  used <- rep(FALSE, length(x_grid))
  for (x0 in evals$x) used[closest_idx(x0, x_grid)] <- TRUE
  
  best_so_far <- numeric(budget + 1)
  best_so_far[1] <- min(evals$y)
  
  for (t in 1:budget) {
    fit <- bass(
      xx = matrix(evals$x, ncol = 1),
      y = evals$y,
      degree = 2,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # Posterior predictive draws
    pred <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_grid))
    pred_mat <- as.matrix(pred)
    
    # Robust orientation: rows = draws, cols = candidates
    if (ncol(pred_mat) != length(x_grid) && nrow(pred_mat) == length(x_grid)) {
      pred_mat <- t(pred_mat)
    }
    
    mu <- colMeans(pred_mat)
    sd_post <- apply(pred_mat, 2, sd)
    
    # Lower Confidence Bound (minimization)
    lcb <- mu - kappa * sd_post
    lcb[used] <- Inf
    
    idx_next <- which.min(lcb)
    x_next <- x_grid[idx_next]
    y_next <- f(x_next)
    
    evals <- bind_rows(evals, tibble(x = x_next, y = y_next))
    used[idx_next] <- TRUE
    best_so_far[t + 1] <- min(evals$y)
  }
  
  list(evals = evals, best_so_far = best_so_far)
}
```

```{r gp-bo-function}
run_gp_bo <- function(x_init, y_init, x_grid, budget, kappa, eps = 1e-8) {
  evals <- tibble(x = x_init, y = y_init)
  
  used <- rep(FALSE, length(x_grid))
  for (x0 in evals$x) used[closest_idx(x0, x_grid)] <- TRUE
  
  best_so_far <- numeric(budget + 1)
  best_so_far[1] <- min(evals$y)
  
  for (t in 1:budget) {
    fit <- GP_fit(
      X = matrix(evals$x, ncol = 1),
      Y = evals$y
    )
    
    pred <- predict(
      object = fit,
      xnew = matrix(x_grid, ncol = 1)
    )
    
    mu <- as.numeric(pred$Y_hat)
    sd_gp <- sqrt(pmax(as.numeric(pred$MSE), 0) + eps)
    
    lcb <- mu - kappa * sd_gp
    lcb[used] <- Inf
    
    idx_next <- which.min(lcb)
    x_next <- x_grid[idx_next]
    y_next <- f(x_next)
    
    evals <- bind_rows(evals, tibble(x = x_next, y = y_next))
    used[idx_next] <- TRUE
    best_so_far[t + 1] <- min(evals$y)
  }
  
  list(evals = evals, best_so_far = best_so_far)
}
```

```{r random-search-function}
run_random_search <- function(x_init, y_init, budget) {
  evals <- tibble(x = x_init, y = y_init)
  
  best_so_far <- numeric(budget + 1)
  best_so_far[1] <- min(evals$y)
  
  for (t in 1:budget) {
    x_next <- runif(1, 0, 1)
    y_next <- f(x_next)
    evals <- bind_rows(evals, tibble(x = x_next, y = y_next))
    best_so_far[t + 1] <- min(evals$y)
  }
  
  list(evals = evals, best_so_far = best_so_far)
}
```

```{r experiment-run}
res_bass <- run_bass_bo(x_init, y_init, x_grid, budget, kappa)
res_gp   <- run_gp_bo(x_init, y_init, x_grid, budget, kappa, eps)
res_rand <- run_random_search(x_init, y_init, budget)
```

```{r convergence-data}
conv_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(iter = 0:budget, best = res_bass$best_so_far, method = "BASS-BO"),
  tibble(iter = 0:budget, best = res_gp$best_so_far,   method = "GP-BO"),
  tibble(iter = 0:budget, best = res_rand$best_so_far, method = "Random Search")
)

head(conv_df)
```

```{r convergence-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(conv_df, aes(x = iter, y = best, color = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Convergence Comparison (Best-So-Far Objective)",
    x = "Iteration (after initialization)",
    y = "Best objective value found"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r summary-table}
summary_tbl <- conv_df %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarize(
    final_best = best[which.max(iter)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(final_best)

summary_tbl
```

```{r summary-gt}
summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Final Best Objective by Method")
```

```{r}
# Candidate grid for plotting
x_new <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)

# --- BASS posterior (mean + sd from posterior draws) ---
get_bass_posterior <- function(evals, x_grid, degree = 2) {
  fit <- bass(
    xx = matrix(evals$x, ncol = 1),
    y = evals$y,
    degree = degree,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_grid))
  pred_mat <- as.matrix(pred)
  
  # Robust orientation handling: rows=draws, cols=x_grid
  if (ncol(pred_mat) != length(x_grid) && nrow(pred_mat) == length(x_grid)) {
    pred_mat <- t(pred_mat)
  }
  
  mu <- colMeans(pred_mat)
  sigma <- apply(pred_mat, 2, sd)
  
  list(mu = mu, sigma = sigma)
}

# --- GP posterior (mean + sd from predictive MSE) ---
get_gp_posterior <- function(evals, x_grid, eps = 1e-8) {
  fit <- GP_fit(
    X = matrix(evals$x, ncol = 1),
    Y = evals$y
  )
  
  pred <- predict(fit, xnew = matrix(x_grid, ncol = 1))
  mu <- as.numeric(pred$Y_hat)
  sigma <- sqrt(pmax(as.numeric(pred$MSE), 0) + eps)
  
  list(mu = mu, sigma = sigma)
}

```

```{r}
plot_posterior_panel <- function(x_grid, evals, title,
                                 mu = NULL, sigma = NULL,
                                 show_posterior = TRUE) {
  y_true <- f(x_grid)
  
  y_lim <- range(
    c(y_true, evals$y,
      if (!is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) mu + sigma else NA,
      if (!is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) mu - sigma else NA),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  # True function
  plot(
    x_grid, y_true, type = "l", lwd = 1.5,
    xlab = "x", ylab = "f(x)", main = title, ylim = y_lim
  )
  
  if (show_posterior && !is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) {
    polygon(
      c(x_grid, rev(x_grid)),
      c(mu + sigma, rev(mu - sigma)),
      col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.20), border = NA
    )
    lines(x_grid, mu, lwd = 2, lty = "dotted")
  }
  
  # Evaluated points
  points(evals$x, evals$y, pch = 16, cex = 0.7)
}

```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
# Compute posteriors for surrogate-based methods
post_bass <- get_bass_posterior(res_bass$evals, x_new)
post_gp   <- get_gp_posterior(res_gp$evals, x_new)

par(cex = 1.0, mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

# 1) BASS-BO posterior
plot_posterior_panel(
  x_grid = x_new,
  evals = res_bass$evals,
  title = "BASS-BO Posterior",
  mu = post_bass$mu,
  sigma = post_bass$sigma,
  show_posterior = TRUE
)

# 2) GP-BO posterior
plot_posterior_panel(
  x_grid = x_new,
  evals = res_gp$evals,
  title = "GP-BO Posterior",
  mu = post_gp$mu,
  sigma = post_gp$sigma,
  show_posterior = TRUE
)

# 3) Random Search (no surrogate posterior)
plot_posterior_panel(
  x_grid = x_new,
  evals = res_rand$evals,
  title = "Random Search (No Posterior)",
  show_posterior = FALSE
)

```



```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=4}
# Add iteration number to eval data frame
add_iter <- function(evals, n0) {
  evals %>%
    mutate(
      iter = row_number() - 1,                 # starts at 0
      phase = ifelse(iter < n0, "init", "bo")
    )
}

plot_posterior_panel <- function(x_grid, evals, title,
                                 n0,
                                 mu = NULL, sigma = NULL,
                                 show_posterior = TRUE) {
  y_true <- f(x_grid)
  
  y_lim <- range(
    c(y_true, evals$y,
      if (!is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) mu + sigma else NA,
      if (!is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) mu - sigma else NA),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  # Base: true function
  plot(
    x_grid, y_true, type = "l", lwd = 1.5,
    xlab = "x", ylab = "f(x)", main = title, ylim = y_lim
  )
  
  # Posterior ribbon + mean
  if (show_posterior && !is.null(mu) && !is.null(sigma)) {
    polygon(
      c(x_grid, rev(x_grid)),
      c(mu + sigma, rev(mu - sigma)),
      col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.20), border = NA
    )
    lines(x_grid, mu, lwd = 2, lty = "dotted")
  }
  
  # Color points by iteration: red -> green
  evals2 <- add_iter(evals, n0)
  n_pts <- nrow(evals2)
  cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("red", "green"))(n_pts)
  
  points(evals2$x, evals2$y, pch = 16, cex = 0.85, col = cols)
  
  # Optional: highlight initial points with black border
  idx_init <- which(evals2$iter < n0)
  if (length(idx_init) > 0) {
    points(evals2$x[idx_init], evals2$y[idx_init], pch = 1, cex = 1.05, lwd = 1)
  }
  
  legend(
    "topright",
    legend = c("True f(x)", "Posterior mean", "±1 sd band", "Early → Late"),
    lty = c(1, 3, NA, NA),
    lwd = c(1.5, 2, NA, NA),
    pch = c(NA, NA, 15, 16),
    pt.cex = c(NA, NA, 1.2, 1),
    col = c("black", "black", rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.20), "red"),
    bty = "n"
  )
}

x_new <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)

get_bass_posterior <- function(evals, x_grid, degree = 2) {
  fit <- bass(
    xx = matrix(evals$x, ncol = 1),
    y = evals$y,
    degree = degree,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_grid))

get_gp_posterior <- function(evals, x_grid, eps = 1e-8) {

    X = matrix(evals$x, ncol = 1),

  )

# Build posteriors for surrogate-based methods
post_bass <- get_bass_posterior(res_bass$evals, x_new)
post_gp   <- get_gp_posterior(res_gp$evals, x_new)

par(cex = 1.0, mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

plot_posterior_panel(
  x_grid = x_new,
  evals = res_bass$evals,
  title = "BASS-BO Posterior",
  n0 = n0,
  mu = post_bass$mu,
  sigma = post_bass$sigma,
  show_posterior = TRUE
)

plot_posterior_panel(
  x_grid = x_new,
  evals = res_gp$evals,
  title = "GP-BO Posterior",
  n0 = n0,
  mu = post_gp$mu,
  sigma = post_gp$sigma,
  show_posterior = TRUE
)

plot_posterior_panel(
  x_grid = x_new,
  evals = res_rand$evals,
  title = "Random Search (No Posterior)",
  n0 = n0,
  show_posterior = FALSE
)
```
